findings: The regular curriculum comprises 60 EC per year. The dated catalogue and regulations support one 10 EC faculty-wide choice, one 10 EC excursion, an open 30 EC minor and one 15 EC thesis. Completion of the first year supplies the named progression requirement. The selected course choices are neutral and no specific excursion placement is assumed.

The closest option combines visual art, objects, heritage and methods. The second gives greater attention to modern museums, screen media and cultural memory. The third connects heritage and visual interpretation with ecology, water governance and spatial analysis. All three schedules satisfy the current workbook constraints.
